overview.en:
Search email, read threads and manage drafts and labels through Google’s official Gmail API with your Google account.

Review email conversations and prepare replies using the connected mailbox context. Keep thread, recipient, and draft details explicit; a prepared reply is not a sent message.

Select Connect in the plugin details. One Google account connection is shared by every installed Google plugin; granted permissions still limit each service.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方 Gmail API 与已连接的 Google 账号检索邮件、阅读会话并管理草稿与标签。

结合已连接邮箱上下文查看邮件会话并准备回复，明确会话、收件人和草稿内容；准备好回复不等于已经发送。

在插件详情中选择“连接”。所有已安装的 Google 插件共用一次 Google 账号连接，各服务仍受已授予权限的限制。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this email thread and identify the response it needs.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 总结这个邮件会话，并判断需要回复哪些事项。

starterPrompts.en: Find the recent emails about this project and extract follow-up items.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个项目的近期邮件，提取后续事项。

starterPrompts.en: Draft a reply to this thread for me to review before sending.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个会话起草回复，发送前交给我审阅。

descriptions.en: Use Gmail in Ghast. Search email, read threads and manage drafts and labels through Google’s official Gmail API with your Google account. 通过 Google 官方 Gmail API 与已连接的 Google 账号检索邮件、阅读会话并管理草稿与标签。
